name: merkle_drift
notes: For a commit graph (section 6.3). Deliberately gentle on the pedals: hash bytes are already indistinguishable from noise, so there is no structure left for xor_mask or bitcrush to break -- they would only relabel one kind of randomness as another. Instead delta reads the blips (a held value between commits is silence), mod_reduce pulls those blips onto a scale so the sparse branches sound like an instrument rather than static, and cross_mix lets the trunk perturb the branches the way a merge perturbs a repo.
